steps.step: A1 after the fight, case open

watch.text: The watch The constables who fought you at your door know your face, and you look as they remember. The magistrate would fine you 90 pence. Talk to him Pay the fine · 90 pence You hold 1 pence, short of the fine. Show your papers You hold no papers he would read. Walk away
